text: Rewrite each card on the decisions page so the owner can tell what they are deciding in five seconds. The owner's words on 3 Nov: 'It's garbo. I don't have a sense of what I'm deciding.' Each card today leads with a problem statement and file paths. Instead each card leads with: the decision as one yes/no question in plain words (for example 'Add a design step before every job?'); one line on what happens if yes and one on what happens if no; cost and risk in a few words; Athena's recommendation and its one-line reason. Evidence paths and record ids go in a collapsed section below. No jargon (no rung names, role names or record kinds in the visible text). Depends on the decisions-page fix that shows only open proposals. Acceptance: a test that renders a card from a sample proposal and checks the question, yes, no, cost and recommendation lines appear before any path; the audience role rates a sample page against the owner-style rules.
